title: 2020 年 12 月英语六级真题（第 2 套）

analysis.topic: 港珠澳大桥工程成就与大湾区发展
analysis.reference: With a total length of 55 kilometers, the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge is an extraordinary engineering feat of China. Connecting three cities, it is the world's longest cross-sea bridge and tunnel system. The bridge has reduced the travel time among the three cities from 3 hours to 30 minutes. This massive reinforced concrete bridge with an enormous span is a full testament to China's ability to build record-breaking mega-structures. It will help boost regional integration and promote economic growth. The bridge is key to China's master plan for developing its own Greater Bay Area. China hopes to build the Greater Bay Area into a region that can rival the bay areas of San Francisco, New York, and Tokyo in technological innovation and economic prosperity.

sentences.cn: 港珠澳大桥全长55公里，是我国一项不同寻常的工程壮举。
sentences.en: With a total length of 55 kilometers, the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge is an extraordinary engineering feat of China.
sentences.structure: with 介词短语作状语 + 主系表结构，将数据信息前置为伴随状语，主句突出核心评价。
keys: 港珠澳大桥 the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge

sentences.cn: 大桥将三个城市连接起来，是世界上最长的跨海桥梁和隧道系统。
sentences.en: Connecting three cities, it is the world's longest cross-sea bridge and tunnel system.
sentences.structure: 现在分词短语作状语 + 主系表结构，用分词短语表达并列信息，避免两个简单句并列的松散结构。

sentences.cn: 大桥将三个城市之间的旅行时间从3小时缩短到30分钟。
sentences.en: The bridge has reduced the travel time among the three cities from 3 hours to 30 minutes.
sentences.structure: 主谓宾结构 + from...to... 介词短语表示变化范围，使用现在完成时表示已经实现的成果。

sentences.cn: 这座跨度巨大的钢筋混凝土大桥充分证明中国有能力建造创纪录的巨型建筑。
sentences.en: This massive reinforced concrete bridge with an enormous span is a full testament to China's ability to build record-breaking mega-structures.
sentences.structure: 主系表结构 + be a testament to 短语 + 不定式作后置定语修饰 ability，多重修饰语叠加构成长句。
keys: 跨度巨大的 with an enormous span
充分证明 is a full testament to

sentences.cn: 它将助推区域一体化，促进经济增长。
sentences.en: It will help boost regional integration and promote economic growth.
sentences.structure: 主语 + will + 并列谓语结构（help boost... and promote...），简洁表达双重作用。
keys: 促进经济增长 promote economic growth

sentences.cn: 大桥是中国发展自己的大湾区总体规划的关键。
sentences.en: The bridge is key to China's master plan for developing its own Greater Bay Area.
sentences.structure: 主系表结构 + be key to 短语 + for doing 介词短语作后置定语，注意 key 在此为形容词用法。
keys: 大湾区 the Greater Bay Area

sentences.cn: 中国希望将大湾区建成在技术创新和经济繁荣上能与旧金山、纽约和东京的湾区相媲美的地区。
sentences.en: China hopes to build the Greater Bay Area into a region that can rival the bay areas of San Francisco, New York, and Tokyo in technological innovation and economic prosperity.
sentences.structure: 主语 + hopes to + build...into + 定语从句（that can rival...in...），长定语从句修饰 region，是全文最复杂的句子。

pitfalls: 「钢筋混凝土」误拼为 reinforced cement 或遗漏 reinforced
「相媲美」误用 compare 而非 rival / compete with，搭配不当
「总体规划」译为 general plan 不够专业，应用 master plan
「从3小时缩短到30分钟」介词搭配错误，必须用 from...to... 搭配 reduce
「创纪录的」遗漏翻译或误译为 breaking records，应用复合形容词 record-breaking
